title: Medusa
tagline: Autonomously store and compute over data through a workflow of  interconnected AI agents, or “heads" built with Covalent's AgentKit and Privy's Server Wallet tools.
description:
**Challenge**

Storage and  Security, as well as Contributors' trust, are significant challenges met when crowdsourcing data. These obstacles disrupt the mass adoption and scalability of DePIN solutions.

**Solutions**

*Medusa Bridge* is an orchestration layer that connects autonomous AI agents, built with Covalent's  Zee-Agentkit and powered by Privy Server Wallet, to scale DePIN.

This integration forms a multi-headed system, where each “snakehead” is an autonomous AI agent with specialized capabilities to enhance data collection, validation, and analysis.

*DePIN Tokenization and Settlement Layer*:  Each execution of the Agentic Workflow is updated on the registry contract deployed on Base, and can serve as a foundation for reward-based token mining, creating a DePIN-driven market for data contributors.
how_its_made:
Medusa is built on a stack of *Zee tools* that enable AI agents to autonomously collect, validate, and analyze data independently

- **Covalent’s Zee-Agentkit** – Powers agent logic, tools, and workflow of the Medusa Bridge.

- **Privy Server Wallet** – Grants AI agents' true autonomy by enabling them to sign signatures and update contract states on captured data.

- **Policy Engine** – Restricts all value transfers on the agent’s server wallet, ensuring it is solely used for predefined purposes on the smart contract, and eliminating the risk of fund drainage.
	
**Agent Workflow:**

	•	CollectionAgent – Captures and signs data securely.
	•	BroadcastingAgent – Manages IPNS/storage and broadcasts state updates.
	•	ResponseAgent – Analyzes data and determines policies based on predefined conditions.

**Other Tools & Infrastructure:**

	 •	Lighthouse for IPFS/IPNS decentralized storage.
	 •	Base Sepolia for smart contract interactions.
	 •	OpenAI’s GPT-4 for agent intelligence.
	 •	CDP Client Bundler and RPC.
